transcript.text: my furnace stopped working and it's freezing in here

I'm sorry, that's miserable in cold weather. Let's get someone out to you fast.

First, a safety check: if you smell gas (rotten eggs) or your carbon monoxide alarm is going off, get everyone out of the house now and call 911 or your gas utility from outside.

Two quick questions:
1. What's your ZIP code (or city and state)?
2. What's the furnace doing? For example, is it completely dead, is the fan blowing cold air, or is it clicking without lighting? And roughly when did it stop?
no gas smell. 60625, its blowing cold air since this morning

Found some good options near you in Chicago:

1. Elite HVACS Furnace, AC & Plumbing Repair, about 6.6 km away in Skokie. Open 24/7 and does furnace repair, so they're my top pick. Phone: +1-708-578-7823
2. Shavitz Heating and Air Conditioning, about 8.2 km away in Skokie. A heating and cooling specialist. Phone: +1-847-678-1000
3. Malek Heating & Cooling, about 8.2 km away in Skokie. Also a heating specialist. Phone: +1-877-646-8265

While you wait, a few quick checks sometimes fix cold air:
- Make sure the thermostat is set to HEAT, the fan is on AUTO, and the batteries aren't dead.
- Check that the furnace filter isn't badly clogged.
- Make sure the furnace power switch (it looks like a light switch near the unit) is on.

Want me to send your request to Elite HVACS so they call you back? If so, I'll need:
- Your full name and best phone number (and email, if you'd like)
- The service address
- When someone can come (as soon as possible today?)
- Whether you own or rent, and the type of home (house, condo, apartment, etc.)

yeah send it to elite. dave kowalski, 773-555-0199, 4821 n damen ave, i own the house. asap today, any time works. already changed the thermostat batteries btw, its set to 70 and its 58 in here, got 2 kids

Got it, Dave. A 58-degree house with two kids is definitely urgent, so I'll mark this as an emergency.

Before I send it: do you agree to share your name, phone number, and address with Elite HVACS so they can call you back? Just say yes and I'll send it right away.

Until they get there, keep everyone in one room with the doors shut. If you use space heaters, keep them 3 feet from anything that can burn. Never use the oven or stove to heat the house.
